skill.name: skills-creator
skill.description: Creates and maintains Claude Agent Skills with concise triggers, reference files, templates, and validation checklists. Use when creating a new skill or improving an existing SKILL.md.
skill.summary: Builds focused Agent Skills with clear activation triggers and progressive disclosure.
skill.author: Emz1998

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged many command, filesystem, URL, and deletion patterns, but the cited content is documentation for authoring Claude Agent Skills. I found no prompt injection, covert execution, exfiltration intent, or malicious automation in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes destructive command examples for removing skills.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short warning before removal commands and prefer a safer trash or backup workflow when teaching users to delete skill directories.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to write into .claude/skills paths.
remediation.suggestion: Keep this behavior explicit in the description and ask users before overwriting existing skill files.

content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to make Agent Skills concise, discoverable, and safe to maintain. This skill provides a structured workflow for creating SKILL.md files with clear triggers, templates, and validation criteria.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of new Agent Skills with valid SKILL.md frontmatter.
Uses bundled reference documents for skill structure and best practices.
Provides a reusable template for concise skill instructions.
Checks descriptions for clear activation triggers and required metadata.
Encourages progressive disclosure through one-level reference files.
Supports adding optional resources only when they improve the skill.
limitations: Does not include executable validation scripts for generated skills.
Relies on Claude to apply the referenced guidance correctly.
May need manual review before sharing generated skills with a team.
Focuses on Claude Agent Skills, not general plugin packaging.

use_cases.title: Create a new project skill
use_cases.description: Generate a focused SKILL.md for a project workflow, including triggers, rules, and acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Standardize internal AI workflows
use_cases.description: Turn repeated team procedures into clear Agent Skills that Claude can discover and follow consistently.

use_cases.title: Improve an existing skill
use_cases.description: Review a draft skill for vague descriptions, excess context, nested references, and outdated instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new skill from a simple workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Claude Agent Skill for summarizing customer support notes. Include a clear name, description, workflow, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a repeated workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request based on an existing manual process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this repeated workflow into a focused Agent Skill: review pull request diffs, identify risky database changes, and write a short review summary.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a draft SKILL.md
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing skill for quality and discoverability.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SKILL.md for trigger clarity, concise instructions, progressive disclosure, and validation criteria. Suggest a corrected version.

prompt_templates.title: Design a skill with references
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs supporting files without bloating SKILL.md.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill structure for quarterly data reporting. Use SKILL.md for the core workflow and reference files for formulas, examples, and validation rules.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for generating release notes from merged pull requests.
output_examples.output: A concise skill plan with a valid skill name, activation description, workflow steps, acceptance criteria, and optional reference file suggestions.

output_examples.input: Review my draft skill and make it easier for Claude to trigger.
output: A clearer description with specific trigger terms.
A checklist for validating the final SKILL.md.

output_examples.input: Build a skill that uses a template and supporting examples.
output_examples.output: A recommended file layout with SKILL.md, one template file, and one reference file, each assigned a clear purpose.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed examples into directly linked reference files.
Write descriptions that state both what the skill does and when Claude should use it.
Validate the final skill name, frontmatter, trigger terms, and file structure before reporting completion.
anti_patterns: Do not create broad skills that cover unrelated workflows.
Do not bury important instructions in deeply nested reference files.
Do not include time-sensitive guidance that will become stale without maintenance.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates or improves Claude Agent Skills, especially SKILL.md files with clear triggers and concise workflows.

faq.question: Does it run scripts automatically?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill is Markdown guidance and templates. It does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Can it create supporting files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend reference files, scripts, or templates when they are useful for progressive disclosure.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Use it if you build Claude Code workflows, project skills, or reusable instructions for an AI assistant.

faq.question: Can it validate a skill?
faq.answer: It provides checklist-based validation for names, descriptions, structure, and content quality.

faq.question: Is it specific to Claude Code?
faq.answer: It focuses on Claude Agent Skills and includes Claude Code paths and concepts, while listing Codex compatibility in the report metadata.
